steps.content: [Transition] White screen, dizzy sound effects like heartbeat and panting
But you don't remember what happened.
[Transition] 2 seconds, ears ringing, murky chaos, blurry vision
Your consciousness feels shattered and disjointed. You fail at every attempt to piece it back together and make sense of things again. You can't see or hear anything discernible before you.
Someone comes to your side, but only a vague impression remains in your mind.
□□ said □□□ stop □□□□ you can't hold out □□□□...
You can't hear what she's saying, but...
The rewind succeeded, and the operation must continue. You remember that you need to buy more time and challenge this Sinner again, and uncover the truth behind her bit by bit.
